communicationScope: Actual archived typed proposals and explicitly reviewed delivered collaborator messages. Private conversations and sealed task identities are withheld; absent messages are not invented.

liveStats.scope: Computed at publication from the current stage report, the run log and the archive. The finish time is an estimate from the pace so far.
